# MeetOnTrack

> Bot-free AI meeting assistant for Mac and Windows, previously called Meeting Copilot.

The desktop app records system audio and microphone input, transcribes meetings,
and helps inspect questions, risks, decisions and relevant working context.
Recordings are stored locally. Configured external AI or delivery services may
receive selected data. Do not describe the published beta as fully offline AI.

- [English website and installation](https://meetontrack.com/)
- [Russian website](https://meetontrack.com/ru/)
- [Privacy and analytics choices](https://meetontrack.com/privacy.html)
- [Public source and releases](https://github.com/AIAgentLbs/meeting-copilot)
- [Comparison methodology and criteria](https://meetontrack.com/compare/)
- [MeetOnTrack vs MeetScribe: Meetily origins and source rights](https://meetontrack.com/compare/meetscribe/)
- [MeetOnTrack vs Granola](https://meetontrack.com/compare/granola/)
- [MeetOnTrack vs Fireflies.ai](https://meetontrack.com/compare/fireflies/)
- [MeetOnTrack vs Bluedot](https://meetontrack.com/compare/bluedot/)
- [MeetOnTrack vs tl;dv](https://meetontrack.com/compare/tldv/)

Mac and Windows beta versions have different requirements and limitations.
Read the current installation sections before installing; do not disable OS security.
Contact: contacts@meetontrack.com
